paragraphs.text: The children of God are not unmindful of a benefit received.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Their arrogant malice would not allow them to see the simplicity of David's heart: therefore their counsel turned to the destruction of their country.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That they deserved David's displeasure, for the harm done to his ambassadors.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: These were various parts of the country of Syria, by which it appears that the Syrians served where they might have entertainment, as now the Sweitzers do.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Here it is declared why war should be undertaken: for the defence of true religion and God's people.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Who were the chief and most principal: for in all he destroyed 7000, as in 1Ch 19:18, or the soldiers who were in 700 chariots.
